newsitem.title: UK: GKN gains as Merrill rates "accumulate".
newsitem.headline: GKN gains as Merrill rates "accumulate".

text.p: Shares in GKN Plc rose on Monday as analysts at Merrill Lynch repeated an "accumulate" rating on the stock following a meeting with the company to review trading during 1996, traders said.
The stock was up 18-1/2p at 11.26 GMT, extending a rebound since it closed at a two-month low of 10.67 stg on November 18.

Analyst Adam Collins at Merrill said the recent setback in the stock had been overdone and worries over sterling's advance had been exaggerated, since GKN had hedged its UK exports with contracts lasting between six months and three years.
He said feedback from GKN was that trading was in line with expectations, and that he believed earlier negative comments from T&N and Laird reflected issues specific to those companies.
Collins said he continued to favour the stock because of its strong position in fast-growing markets in Asia, Latin America and among Japanese auto companies manufacturing in the UK.
